description: Los Angeles International Airport - Terminal Concession Locations is a dataset listed in City of Los Angeles open data portal (data.lacity.org), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Los Angeles. Export of Concession information found in LAX content management system with generic information of available concessions at LAX. Coverage: Los Angeles. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are airport concessions tenant lax. The table has 26 columns. Attribution on the portal: Los Angeles World Airports. The portal shows 2024-05-01 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-lacity-org-portal.
